title: From a model call to a configurable chatbot
summary: Conversation memory, optional PII processing, provider configuration and tracing in the LangChain chatbot project.
lead: A model API can return an answer in a few lines of code. A reusable chatbot needs more decisions: how to keep a conversation, how to configure behavior, which provider to call, what to store and how to debug a bad answer. This project turns those decisions into a full application with MongoDB memory, optional Presidio anonymization, provider configuration and LangSmith tracing.

diagram.chart:
graph LR
    UI["Chat interface"] --> API["Backend"]
    API --> MEM[("MongoDB history")]
    API --> PII["Presidio anonymizer (optional)"]
    PII --> LLM["OpenAI / Vertex AI"]
    LLM --> PII
    API -.-> TRACE["LangSmith traces"]
diagram.caption: The backend owns configuration and orchestration. Memory, anonymization, the model provider and tracing are separate components.

sections.title: Separate the interface from orchestration
paragraphs: The project began with a Gradio interface (v1.0 in the changelog). The repository now contains a Next.js frontend and a FastAPI backend, which is the version described here.

A message travels from the interface to a backend that owns bot configuration and orchestration. Model integration, conversation memory and optional anonymization are separate components, not behavior hard-coded into a UI callback. That makes it easier to change a provider or a prompt, and easier to locate a failure: an empty answer can come from transport, prompt assembly, model invocation or output handling, and those layers stay distinguishable.

sections.title: Scope memory to the conversation
paragraphs: The MongoDB memory adapter is configured with a connection, database, collection and session identifier. The session identifier matters most: history should load for the intended conversation, not for whichever request last updated a shared variable.

Persistent history gives continuity across requests, and it brings obligations. Retention, deletion and access isolation need deliberate decisions. Storing history also does not mean every earlier message belongs in every new prompt, so context selection is a separate concern.

sections.title: Put PII handling at the provider boundary
paragraphs: The project wraps LangChain's PresidioReversibleAnonymizer as an optional layer, enabled with ENABLE_ANONYMIZER and off by default. It detects the language, anonymizes the input, the conversation history and the agent scratchpad before the model call, and maps the substituted values back in the reply, so the user sees a natural answer and the provider never receives the original value.

The boundary is configuration and data flow. An anonymizer does not guarantee that every sensitive span is detected, and it only helps in deployments where it is switched on. Raw history, traces and model input can follow different paths, so each one needs inspection.

sections.title: Use configuration and tracing to iterate
paragraphs: Bot behavior and provider choice are configurable, including OpenAI and Vertex AI options. LangSmith provides prompt versioning and tracing, which makes it possible to see which prompt and execution path produced a given response.
Traces have privacy implications of their own. A good debugging setup shows enough structure to understand a failure without assuming every user message is safe to keep in a third-party dashboard.

figures.alt: LangSmith trace of the deanonymize step restoring the original phone number in the reply
figures.caption: The deanonymize step maps the substitute back to the original number in the reply.

sections.title: Package the pieces so they run together
paragraphs: The repository documents a containerized setup for the frontend, backend and database. That removes repeated manual setup and makes the service boundaries visible.

The outcome is a configurable chatbot foundation with persistent memory, provider selection, optional anonymization and inspection tools. There is no benchmark here for throughput, response quality or cost. A useful next evaluation would run fixed conversations while varying prompts, context windows and privacy settings.
